Win round two of [[the Norn Fighting Tournament]].

==Quest information==

===Objectives===
*Defeat your second round opponent in Magni the Bison's tournament.

===Reward===
:''No quest reward''
*You gain 10 [[Norn Reputation Point]]s for killing your foe (unless Norn rank 8 or above)
*You gain a quest reward after beating all 6 rounds, see [[Final Round: Fight!]] (first time completion) or [[Final Round, Championship Edition: Fight!]] (for repeated victories)

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Magni the Bison
:''"'''[Solo Quest]''' Welcome back, whelp! In the '''second round''' of the '''tournament''' you'll encounter some new foes. They can hold their weapons, but they don't know how to use them. You should fit in well."''

===Intermediate dialogue===
:(The dialogue depends on which opponent you are facing. See [[the Norn Fighting Tournament]] article for the dialogue and quotes.)

==Notes==
*Round two opponents may be [[Alesia]], [[Melonni]], [[Norgu]], [[Old Mac]] with [[Joe]], [[Orion]], [[Vekk]], or [[Xandra]]. Please refer to [[the Norn Fighting Tournament]] article for details on their skill sets.
*This quest is automatically accepted upon completing the preceding quest (that is, winning the round 1 of the tournament). It is also automatically completed upon defeating the round 2 opponent  and the follow-up quest [[Round 3: Fight!]] is automatically accepted.
